About Zenith Tutorials

Zenith is an online tutorial that prepares students for JAMB. Our classes run in Telegram groups, with live teaching, practice and personal guidance from Dr. Elijah and the team.

Live classes and revision

Subject zones meet for scheduled lessons and revision classes before the exam.

Constant drills

Students practise the kinds of questions they will meet in the real exam.

Materials and flashcards

Recommended study materials and flashcards help students revise on their own.

Personal mentorship

Students get direct advice and orientation on how to approach the exam.
